tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background for every site and the dashboard. Never pure black.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Code boxes, terminal blocks, table header rows, form inputs.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows and nav items, a quiet inner panel (outlier row). Not for whole cards.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Sidebar divider, row dividers inside tables and lists.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px border for cards, strips and tables.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, chips, inputs and code boxes.

tokens.name: line-header
tokens.usage: Header bottom border; empty track of progress bars.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, card titles, plain numbers, current family-nav label. 15:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on bg, bg-sunken and bg-raised. 14:1 on bg. Never pure white.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Lede paragraphs, secondary links, trend values. 8.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-nav
tokens.usage: Sidebar links at rest. 9.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, table header text, mono group labels. 6.1:1 on bg, passes at 11.5px.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Code comments, '/ 11' suffixes, 'no data'. 4.1:1 on bg: only for text 17px+ or non-essential hints.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Soft mint for ordinary links. 11:1 on bg. Not a highlight colour.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover.

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: Highlights only: active nav, primary buttons, key numbers, step numbers, current chart bar, progress fills, $ prompt. 13:1 on bg. About 6 per screen.

tokens.name: neon-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the active nav item and active segmented button.

tokens.name: neon-line
tokens.usage: Inset ring on the active nav item; border of the one highlighted card in a section.

tokens.name: neon-bar
tokens.usage: Chart bars that are not the current one.

tokens.name: on-neon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a neon fill (primary button). 14:1 on neon.

tokens.name: dot-idle
tokens.usage: Nav dots for pages you are not on.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings only: warning icons, stale index, failed checks, limits at 70-89%. Pair with an icon or word, never colour alone. 9.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background tile behind a warning icon.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of a warning notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and limits at 90%+. Soft rose, not saturated red. 7.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: role-backend
tokens.usage: Easy Kit agent role dot: backend-developer. 8px dots only.

tokens.name: role-infra
tokens.usage: Easy Kit agent role dot: common-infrastructure. 8px dots only.

tokens.name: role-frontend
tokens.usage: Easy Kit agent role dot: frontend-developer. 8px dots only.

tokens.name: role-qa
tokens.usage: Easy Kit agent role dot: qa-expert. 8px dots only.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One h1 per docs page, text-strong.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles inside cards, strips and steps.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A five-stage pipeline enforced by deterministic hooks.
styles.usage: Intro under h1, text-2, max 680px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notes are stored outside the repo under ~/.easy-memory/.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and labels under numbers, text-muted.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sidebar and family nav links; 500 when active.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Line above h1, lowercase, prefixed '> ', neon.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels, lowercase, prefixed '// ', text-muted.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers in stat strips. Neon only on the key number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a number and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row; button row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Step cell padding; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and strip cell padding (with 22px sides).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dashboard section gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Header side padding; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on docs pages.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Main column top/bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Main column side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, version tag, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav items, code boxes, single cards, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Grouped strips, step grids, table wrappers.

shadow.note: Glows exist only for neon highlights. There are no drop shadows in this system.

tokens.name: glow-text
tokens.usage: text-shadow on neon text (eyebrow, active nav, step and key numbers).

tokens.name: glow-box
tokens.usage: box-shadow on primary buttons, the highlighted card, the current chart bar.

tokens.name: glow-dot
tokens.usage: box-shadow on the current nav dot and on progress fills.

tokens.name: glow-line
tokens.usage: CSS filter on neon sparklines and the cache ring.

layout.note: Shell sizes shared by the three sites.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Docs header height (dashboard top bar: 56px).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Docs sidebar width (dashboard: 232px).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main column on docs pages.
